title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
preamble: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “MNDA”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“Cover Page”) and (2) the Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms Version 1.0 (“Standard Terms”) identical to those posted at {source}. Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
closing: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this MNDA as of the Effective Date.
attribution: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Version 1.0) free to use under CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.hint: How Confidential Information may be used
fields.prompt: what the parties will use each other's confidential information for

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date it takes effect, as yyyy-mm-dd

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.prompt: how long the MNDA lasts: "expires" after a set number of years, or "untilTerminated"

modes.label: Continues until terminated
modes.template: Continues until terminated in accordance with the terms of this MNDA.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.hint: How long Confidential Information is protected
fields.prompt: how long confidentiality lasts: a number of "years", or "perpetual"

modes.label: A set number of years
modes.template: {years} from the Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until the Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.prompt: the city or county and state whose courts hear disputes

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.prompt: any change to the standard terms, otherwise leave it alone

fields.label: Party 1
fields.prompt: the first party: company, name and title of whoever signs, and noticeAddress

fields.label: Party 2
fields.prompt: the second party: company, name and title of whoever signs, and noticeAddress
